worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.summary: Breathe a mystic fireball that seeks one foe: a hit that deals damage takes 1 stage of the target's Sp. Atk and may burn it; the flame then coils around the target, biting every few seconds, and if it lasts the full time it takes 1 more stage of Sp. Atk. A target that gets too far from the caster slips free. The lingering form has a slower, shorter fireball but coils far longer, bites harder and burns more easily at a slightly longer wind-up and cooldown; the swift form flies faster and reaches further.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.0: Coil around a strong special attacker and drain its Sp. Atk
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.1: Chase an evasive foe with a homing flame
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.use.2: Open with a burn, then grind the target down
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.descripti: When the fireball catches a foe it deals about %1$s special damage; if it deals damage, it also takes %2$s stage(s) of the target's Sp. Atk.
The fireball tracks a target within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, turning %3$s degrees/tick.

After a hit that deals damage the flame coils around the target for %1$s, biting for about %2$s special damage every %3$s s; if it lasts the full time it takes %4$s more stage(s) of Sp. Atk. If the target gets more than %5$s blocks away from the caster it slips free and the flame disperses.

After a hit that deals damage there is a %1$s chance to burn the target: the burn lasts 40 seconds, during which the target loses 1/16 of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1) and its physical damage is halved; Fire-type targets cannot be burned.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.on: Lingering form: coils %1$s, %2$s per bite, burn chance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.linger.of: Swift form: coils %1$s, burn chance %2$s, and the fireball is faster and reaches further.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.growth.0: From level %1$s the fireball rises to %2$s power and the coil to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mysticalfire.preferenc: On: a slower, shorter fireball, but coil x1.4, harder bites, burn chance +35%, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks - for coiling one target and grinding it down. Off: a faster, further fireball with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, but less coil and burn.
Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: it prefers targets that are not already burning (the burn and coil are worth most), and ranks burning targets last. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
